title: create_exploration_context inputSchema
description: Argument shape for create_exploration_context (composition profile, ADR-0032). Adds or replaces (by context id) one exploration context in a composition document's `explorationContexts` collection. An exploration context is a named unit of shared interaction state that components join by id; changing a context's preset is expressed as replacing it by id, so there is no separate preset tool. The standard-level target is a composition document (mapPackageId or appPackageId); the reference implementation's optimistic-concurrency draft spelling (draftId + generation) is admitted as x-honua-reference-shape, consistent with ADR-0030's bind_interaction and ADR-0031's add_control. Validation gate: context.id must be unique within the document, every context.sourceIds entry must resolve to a source declared in the target document, and context.preset must be a member of the closed preset vocabulary. See docs/adr/0032-shared-exploration-contexts.md and common/exploration.schema.json.

mapPackageId.description: Target MapPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

appPackageId.description: Target AppPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

draftId.description: x-honua-reference-shape: reference-implementation draft-lifecycle target. Requires generation.

generation.description: x-honua-reference-shape: optimistic-concurrency generation of the draft being mutated; the call fails on generation conflict.

explorationContext.description: The exploration context to add or replace. Replacement matches on explorationContext.id and preserves existing component bindings to that id, so re-authoring a context's preset does not unbind its components.
